turns.prompt_text: Uh, do you see these pieces of wood?
turns.response_html: Sure do! They look like they've been painted with a cool, swirly pattern. Are you working on a woodworking project?

turns.prompt_text: Um, this is going to hold a shelf, but that's not the concern. Uh, I'm trying to paint these so that they are solid white. And I have some paint here, some white paint. But I'm having trouble getting to paint the stick. You can see the first coat it just didn't really go on very well.
turns.response_html: That Glidden Essentials paint should work. It looks like you're painting outside – is it humid or has it rained recently? Moisture on the wood can sometimes prevent paint from sticking well. Make sure the wood is clean and dry, and try applying a thin, even coat of paint. If that doesn't work, you might need to try a primer first.
If the paint still isn't sticking, you could try sanding the wood lightly before applying a new coat. That can help the paint adhere better.
